notes.title: Multiplayer Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Jammers! We’re finally ready to announce something big heading your way! We’ve got a huge new update coming that aims to streamline the multiplayer experience. We’ll be adding plenty of new features. Along with the previous updates to enemy AI to make them less punishing to go up against and more rewarding to beat and some quality of life changes to the overall game, we’re also adding private rooms for multiplayer matches! Now you can skip worrying about strangers and focus on the high-intensity ax-throwing action you crave.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/d2hNnU1.png[/img]

Of course, we’re not only focusing on the things that are immediately noticeable. We’ve been hammering out some of the bugs that have been a detriment to how smooth the Log Jammers experience should be. The AI’s reach should feel fairer now, as well as the various connectivity issues when playing online. However, we’re still in the final stages of preparing this update, so stay tuned for more details in the future!
